en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an old stone canopy structure with four columns and a domed, ornamented roof. Through the arches, a large mosque complex with prominent domes and tall minarets is visible in the background, along with other buildings of a historic cityscape. Handwritten ink text appears at the bottom over the image. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the view as a tomb in Cairo.
